test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
After months of dedication and effort, I finally completed the marathon. I can really ____________ for this accomplishment.

QUESTION

Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

options.text: up a creek without a paddle

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"pat myself on the back"** means to praise or congratulate oneself for an achievement. (स्वयं की प्रशंसा करना)

 
 
• **Example: **After finishing the project on time, I had to pat myself on the back for the hard work I put in.
 
 
 
• **"After months of dedication and effort, I finally completed the marathon. I can really pat myself on the back for this accomplishment."** This sentence implies self-congratulation for a significant achievement. (स्वयं की प्रशंसा करना)
 
 
• **Example: **Completing the marathon was a huge milestone, and I couldn't help but pat myself on the back.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Eat like a horse** (घोड़े की तरह खाना): To eat a lot of food.

 
 
• **Example:** He eats like a horse after his football practice.
 
 
 
• **Up a creek without a paddle** (बिना सहारे के मुसीबत में): To be in a difficult situation without a solution.
 
 
• **Example:** When his car broke down in the middle of nowhere, he was up a creek without a paddle.
 
 
 
• **Blow hot and cold** (अस्थिर होना): To be indecisive or inconsistent in behavior.
 
 
• **Example:** She often blows hot and cold about her career choices, making it hard to keep up with her decisions.
